title: Accessible Video Lesson
prompt: Embed a video with controls and a captions track, then provide transcript guidance nearby.
objective: Build a semantic media block and make the caption asset path explicit.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: captions, transcripts, embedded media.
hints: Captions need a correctly formatted WebVTT file and accurate cue timing.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Captions need a correctly formatted WebVTT file and accurate cue timing. Required structural evidence: <video, controls, <track, kind="captions".

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
